sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. A HOQUE Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN DEV CHOUDHURY  ORDER Date : 19-09-2023 1.
Heard Mr. A Haque, learned counsel for the applicants.

Also heard Mr. R J Baruah, learned Addl.
PP, Assam.
Page No.# 2/3 Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61469327/
1 2.

By this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the applicants, namely, 1. Rashidul Islam, & 2.
Badsha Alom Choudhury have filed an application under section 438 Cr.P.C., with prayer for pre arrest bail in connection with Mankachar PS Case No.258/2023 under section 376/343/34 IPC corresponding to GR Case No.597/2023.
3. Case diary called for is received and perused including the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. Also seen the statement of other witnesses.

4. Having Gone through the Case Diary, and considering the matter in its entirety, this Court is of the opinion that on the basis of materials so far collected, the applicants have made out a good case for granting them pre-arrest bail in as much as considering the stage of the investigation, in the opinion of this Court, no custodial interrogation shall be necessary.

5. As such, this Anticipatory Bail Application is hereby disposed of by providing that in the event of arrest in connection with the aforementioned case, the applicants, above named shall be released on bail on furnishing a bond of Rs.50,000/- each with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
I.

The applicants shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

II. The applicants would render full cooperation with the investigation of the case;
Page No.# 3/3 III.
The applicants shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the concerned I.O. without prior intimation.
IV. The applicants shall appear before the IO of the concerned PS within 10 days 5
The pre-arrest bail application stands disposed off.
